reader.title: Sublinear exponent in clique-width under ETH

sourceBasis.step: An algorithm for intrinsic clique-width could ignore the supplied expression. Intrinsic clique-width is at most the width of that expression, and nondecreasing upper envelopes of the prefactor and exponent preserve the little-o scale.

statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm solves Minimum Bisection within the stated running time.
